start_text: One graph for calculations, failures, BGP and monitoring: in the web interface, through the API and for AI agents.
start_card_paths_text: Shortest paths and ECMP for OSPF, OSPFv3 and IS-IS by level. TE attributes from the LSDB (bandwidth, affinity, SRLG) allow a constrained path calculation (CSPF).
start_card_failures_text: A link or node failure, a cost change, several failures at once: which paths change and where the single points of failure are.
start_card_bgp_text: BGP-LS and BMP on the same graph: Best Path Selection, VPNv4 / VPNv6, EVPN with VNI, ESI and VTEP, the path to a prefix in a VRF.
start_card_mpls_text: LSPs on the graph: ERO, reserved bandwidth, LSPs over shared links and what happens to them on a failure.
start_card_monitoring_text: OSPF, IS-IS and BMP watchers: adjacencies, cost, networks and sessions on a timeline; the graph at any moment.
start_card_reports_text: Asymmetric paths, duplicated networks, a load heat map, snapshot comparison; REST API, Python SDK and an MCP server for AI agents.
upload_text: The «Add» wizard → «LSDB file»: vendor, protocol, file. The commands for your vendor are in the reference.
watcher_text: The watcher wizard: type, session mode, router commands and docker compose.
watcher_enterprise: Watchers are part of the Enterprise edition.
api_text: The OpenAPI schema is at {path}. Authorization: an API token in the {header} header, or login and password from the allowed addresses.
